subject: SET statement
notes: kb/Work/PB452.md LANDED 2026-09-09. GR36 a): NEAREST-TO-ZERO sets the receiver to the nonzero value nearest to zero its own description permits - 10 to the minus scale for a fixed-point description, the carrier's subnormal minimum for a float one, from AlgebraicRanges.Of. GR36 b): the IN-ARITHMETIC-RANGE clamp takes whichever of the item's and the mode's nearest-to-zero values is FARTHER from zero, the mirror of GR32 b) and latent for the same measured reason. GR36 c): the SIGN phrase's sign, positive when absent. MEASURED at --std 2014 on PIC S9(4)V99 SIGN IS LEADING SEPARATE: +000001, and with SIGN NEGATIVE -000001. Annex D.32's equivalence (SET ... TO NEAREST-TO-ZERO IN-ARITHMETIC-RANGE equals MOVE SMALLEST-ALGEBRAIC(x) TO x) is asserted in the 2023 golden, since SMALLEST-ALGEBRAIC is a 2023 function while the format is a 2014 one. SR31 b), the NEAREST-TO-ZERO twin of the mandatory-SIGN rule, has no violating input in this implementation: the nearest-to-zero value is a MAGNITUDE identical in both directions for every description declarable here.
